items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Ken Cut. And this Booyah got a good band too.

ctx.x: What do you think about those English bands? Good bands. What bands do you like over in England in particular?

Kid got a good band. I was over there. Ken Cut. And this Booyah got a good band too. They call him Trummelbill. You know him? Oh. Oh. Oh. Kid's over here. You know there are a couple of good lads here. Chris Barber. Oh yeah. Chris got a good band dude. He played all them bands on concert. He played all them bands on concert.
